svg.title: PangoLock: zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS
svg.desc: ls ~/projects lists PangoLock, RAG_PDF_Genie_with_Local_LLM, the tesseract OCR repos, express_js_prometheus and python-microservice. The PangoLock card shows a spinning luminance-shaded ASCII padlock, the vault core, whose shackle opens while the key flow runs as a shell pipeline: password, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 210,000 iterations, zero-knowledge verifier check, HKDF-SHA256 per-item key, AES-256-GCM seal, atomic write of uuid.plock, decrypt and compare, remove the original, lock. Verify-before-delete: the original is removed only after the sealed copy decrypts and compares. Swift and SwiftUI, macOS 13+, MIT, v0.2.1, 87 XCTest tests, CI on macOS, written threat model, Keychain and Touch ID, recovery key, portable lockers, encrypted sharing.
